packageRules.description: Python non-major updates in one PR. FastAPI and uvicorn stay out and get their own PRs: the FastAPI bump is step 1 of INFRA-105 and can turn on native telemetry.
npm non-major updates in one PR.
GitHub Actions non-major and digest updates in one PR.
Docker non-major and digest updates in one PR.
Library majors wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard, then land one at a time after the non-major groups.
Python runtime upgrade (3.12 to 3.14 is a minor in Renovate's terms): Dockerfiles, requires-python and CI move together in one PR, on dashboard approval only. Owned by TBD-554.
Node runtime upgrade (22 to 24): Dockerfiles, CI and @types/node move together in one PR, on dashboard approval only. Owned by TBD-554.
structlog majors are never proposed: INFRA-105 removes structlog.
Datastore image majors are never proposed: production versions (MySQL 8.4, Valkey 8) are owned by aws-infra, and local and CI images follow them.
DigitalOcean-era infrastructure that INFRA-49 and INFRA-103 remove: no updates.
